title: I tapped ‘Book now’. It went nowhere.
speakerNotes: Optional opening before slide 1: “Hijaz is my favourite maqam. Follow my clicks and count the Ds.” Pause. “You don’t need to count the notes to feel the sadness.” Then tell the hotel visit in your own words. Describe the single observed visit. The cost sentence describes a possibility, with no measured loss attributed to this hotel.

title: Hotel savings can fund local work
description: How the proposed programme would operate
speakerNotes: Net savings account for direct-channel costs as well as commissions. InnMetric and the Tourism Department review the saving, the proposed collection amount and the support decision separately. The department would administer collected funds and execute approved payments. The hotel, InnMetric and the department confirm the final service outcome. InnMetric’s commercial services sit outside the fund.

title: A pilot with two hotels
description: Why the prototype is ready for a pilot discussion
speakerNotes: The prototype uses synthetic hotel records and simulated role decisions and payments. A two-hotel pilot is a proposal. Work with the tourism team to agree on participation, cost records, the savings baseline and how provider work would be verified.

title: The InnMetric team
description: Why us and the request to Dubai’s tourism team
speakerNotes: Mert Carikci and Tunahan Aras are InnMetric’s founders. Introduce Tunahan’s experience tracing booking issues across hotel systems and Mert’s experience in product ownership and systems analysis. Ask for a working conversation and introductions to two independent hotels. Founder reference: https://innmetric.com/about/.
